ERA Tobin Estate Agents are proud to present for sale this truly unique exceptional 5/6-bedroom luxury detached residence with attached garage circa 520m²(5564 sq. ft) set over three levels. Designed by well-known local architect Fergus Flynn Rodgers in the style of a luxury French Country residence, situated on a stunning site circa 0.68 hectares (1.7acres) of amazing landscaped gardens offering privacy and security with the Cooley Mountains as a backdrop. Superbly located less than 5 minutes from the M1 motorway, equal distance from Dublin Airport and Belfast (50 minutes) while offering easy access to the coast and local beaches. It really is so rare for a property of this quality and attention to detail to come to the market and even rarer in this location and setting with planning difficult to acquire in this much sought-after area.
